title: Feature Request: Read Libre sensor with Sony 3 nfc reader
symptom: The user wants to be able to read their Libre sensor with the Sony SmartWatch 3 NFC reader, similar to what Glimp allowed, but xDrip does not support this feature.
evidence_quote: I'm migrating from glimp to xDrip and glimp allowed me to use the nfc reader on my watch to scan the sensor. I think this would be a useful feature.
